FN-DYZZHH-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 71
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Jack Williams
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/03/2023
Senate Bill 71 as introduced could increase by a small undetermined amount, the obligations of
the counties that opt to display the posting of certain public notices digitally as provided by this
bill.
Page 1

Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Jack Williams
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/05/2023
Senate Bill 71 as reported by the Committee on Banking and Insurance could increase by a
small undetermined amount, the obligations of the counties or municipalities that opt to display
the posting of certain public notices digitally as provided by this bill.
